cd /workspace && python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib,shutil,subprocess,json
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/submission')
for d in root.rglob('__pycache__'):
    shutil.rmtree(d)
files=[p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
assert all(not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_nlink==1 for p in root.rglob('*'))
assert len(list(root.rglob('*')))+1<=256
assert sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files)<=8*1024*1024
fixtures=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/workspace/examples/checks.json').read_text())
for i,f in enumerate(fixtures):
    data=f['raw'] if 'raw' in f else json.dumps(f['request'])
    p=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=data.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert p.returncode==0,(i,p.stderr)
    assert json.loads(p.stdout)==f['response'],(i,p.stdout)
print('Final direct checks: all 9 fixtures match.')
print('Submission:',len(files),'files;',sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files),'bytes.')
PY
